title: Browser 10-minute phase harness web/scripts/link-drift.mjs (headless Chrome via Playwright)
description:
## Intent
The browser 10-minute phase harness.

## Steps
Makes apricitus-088a81 green.

1. `web/scripts/link-drift.mjs`: starts `apricity serve --library <temp> --link`, a reference peer (a small native helper from `apricity-link`'s examples, or the drift test binary in reference-only mode), and headless Chrome via Playwright (builds on apricitus-94da2e's setup).
2. The page plays the click score in Link mode; the worklet's output is captured (an `AudioWorkletNode` tap or `MediaRecorder` on a `MediaStreamDestination`), with `AudioContext` times mapped back to server time.
3. Same error measure and report as the native harness, at `renders/link-drift-browser.json`, plus the clock offset's spread.
4. Bounded: stops by itself at 11 minutes.

## Verify
`node web/scripts/link-drift.mjs` under the watchdog (`safe-run.sh -- node web/scripts/link-drift.mjs`); paste the summary.

Labels `daw`, `web`. Commit: `test(<this task id>): browser phase harness`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
